mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade (user_id, sid, sdid, trade_type, trade_price, quantity, total_amount, remaining_balance, trade_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sid}, #{sdid}, #{tradeType}, #{tradePrice}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount},#{remainingBalance}, #{tradeAt})
mapper.select: SELECT trade.tid, stock.sid, stock.company_name as companyName, stock.ticker as ticker, stock.sector as sector, stock.market as market, trade.trade_type as tradeType, trade.trade_price as tradePrice, trade.quantity, trade.total_amount as totalAmount, trade.remaining_balance as remainingBalance, trade.trade_at AS tradeAt FROM trade LEFT JOIN stock ON trade.sid = stock.sid WHERE trade.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT tid, sid, sdid, trade_type as tradeType, trade_price as tradePrice, quantity, total_amount as totalAmount, remaining_balance as remainingBalance, trade_at AS tradeAt FROM trade WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sid = #{sid}

SELECT trade.tid, stock.sid, stock.company_name as companyName, stock.ticker as ticker, stock.sector as sector, stock.market as market, trade.trade_type as tradeType, trade.trade_price as tradePrice, trade.quantity, trade.total_amount as totalAmount, trade.remaining_balance as remainingBalance, trade.trade_at AS tradeAt FROM trade LEFT JOIN stock ON trade.sid = stock.sid WHERE trade.user_id = #{userId} AND trade.tid = #{tid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT SUM(trade.quantity) FROM trade WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sid = #{sid}
